subject.title: fix(ui): reject nondecimal strings in config form number coercion

question: Should generic Control UI number and integer fields continue accepting scientific-notation input such as `1e5`, while rejecting hexadecimal, binary, octal, and leading-plus spellings?
rationale: The branch changes a user-facing input contract across schema-driven config forms; the cron interval precedent is specialized and does not determine the generic configuration grammar.

options.title: Preserve scientific notation
options.body: Extend the shared grammar to accept JSON-style scientific notation while retaining rejection of hexadecimal, binary, octal, and leading-plus forms.

options.title: Adopt decimal-only config input
options.body: Intentionally reject scientific notation across generic config fields and document the compatibility change as the permanent product contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve scientific notation
recommendation.body: Extend the shared grammar to accept JSON-style scientific notation while retaining rejection of hexadecimal, binary, octal, and leading-plus forms.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged Control UI numeric-parser work is the closest adjacent precedent for choosing the intended grammar.
